messages.message: ### Step 2: Morphosyntactic Requirement Definition Goal: For Tamil, specify per-token morphosyntax needed to realize the Step 1 Interpretation Lock. Output: ONE Markdown table only (no prose). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Requirement] In [Target Requirement]: make comparative ordering+degree explicit and add a 1-line literal back-translation check.

| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Requirement (Tamil Morphosyntax + 1‑line literal back‑translation check) | |------------|----------------------|------------------------------------------------------------| | **Nel** | “in the middle of” – locative prepositional phrase introducing the position | Use locative post‑position **‑இல்** attached to the noun “நடு” (middle). **நடுவில்** → *“in the middle”* (back‑translation: “in the middle”) | | **mezzo** | The exact middle point of a journey | Noun **நடு** (masc., singular) with locative **‑இல்** as above. **நடுவில்** → *“midway”* (back‑translation: “midway”) | | **del** | Genitive marker linking *cammin* to *vita* | Tamil genitive **‑இன்** attached to “வாழ்க்கை”. **வாழ்க்கையின்** → *“of life”* (back‑translation: “of life”) | | **cammin** | The path or journey being travelled | Noun **பாதை** (masc., singular). No inflection needed for definiteness. **பாதை** → *“road”* (back‑translation: “road”) | | **di** | Preposition marking possession/association (“our life”) | Expressed by genitive **‑இன்** on “வாழ்க்கை”. Already covered in **del**; here it reinforces **வாழ்க்கையின்**. | | **nostra** | Possessive adjective indicating “our” | Possessive suffix **‑ம்** on “நம்”. **நம்** → *“our”* (back‑translation: “our”) | | **vita** | The span of existence of the speaker and companions | Noun **வாழ்க்கை** (fem., singular). **வாழ்க்கை** → *“life”* (back‑translation: “life”) | | **mi** | Reflexive pronoun, the speaker as experiencer | Reflexive clitic expressed by verb‑inflection; no separate pronoun needed in Tamil. Verb **கண்டுபிடித்தேன்** already encodes first‑person. **(implicit)** → *“I”* (back‑translation: “I”) | | **ritrovai** | “I found myself” – self‑locating action (past remote) | Verb **கண்டுபிடித்தேன்** (1st person, past). Morphology: **‑என்** (first‑person), **‑து** (past). **கண்டுபிடித்தேன்** → *“found”* (back‑translation: “found”) | | **per** | Preposition introducing the spatial domain (“within”) | Tamil locative post‑position **‑இல்** attached to “காடு”. **காடில்** → *“within the forest”* (back‑translation: “within”) | | **una** | Indefinite article marking non‑specific noun | Tamil does not use articles; indefiniteness is inferred. No morphological marking required. **(none)** → *“a”* (back‑translation: “a”) | | **selva** | A forest, the dark environment | Noun **காடு** (masc., singular). **காடு** → *“wood/forest”* (back‑translation: “forest”) | | **oscura** | Qualifies *selva* as lacking light | Adjective **இருண்ட** agreeing in gender/number (masc. singular). **இருண்ட காடு** → *“dark forest”* (back‑translation: “dark forest”) | | **ché** | Conjunction introducing causal clause (“for”) | Tamil causal conjunction **ஏனெனில்**. **ஏனெனில்** → *“because”* (back‑translation: “because”) | | **la** | Definite article specifying particular *via* | Tamil definiteness expressed by demonstrative **அந்த** or by context; here **அந்த** before *via*. **அந்த** → *“the”* (back‑translation: “the”) | | **diritta** | Adjective describing *via* as correct/straight | Adjective **சரியான** (masc., singular) modifying *via*. **சரியான பாதை** → *“right way”* (back‑translation: “right way”) | | **via** | The correct path that should be followed | Noun **பாதை** (fem., singular). **பாதை** → *“way”* (back‑translation: “way”) | | **era** | Copular verb indicating a past state (imperf.) | Verb **இருந்தது** (3rd person, past imperfect). **இருந்தது** → *“was”* (back‑translation: “was”) | | **smarrita** | State of being lost; the way is not found | Past participle used as adjective **இழந்த** (fem., singular) agreeing with *via*. **இழந்த பாதை** → *“missed way”* (back‑translation: “missed”) |

### Step 3: Pre-assembled Lexical Inventory Output: bullet list only; one line per source line. Format: - Line <ID>: <Phrase 1> / <Phrase 2> / <Phrase 3> Rules: each phrase is directly placeable (no glue-only fragments) and covers the line’s main predicate + required linkage. Hook: satisfy Step 2 requirements for that line (incl. back-translation checks). Comparatives: preserve ordering (A>B ⇔ B<A is OK) and degree; at least one phrase must make both recoverable. No punctuation inside phrases; keep phrases short; no newlines.

- Line 1: நம் வாழ்க்கையின் பாதையின் நடுவில் / வாழ்க்கை பாதையின் நடுவில் / நடுவில் நம் வாழ்க்கை பாதை - Line 2: நான் இருண்ட காடில் தன்னை கண்டேன் / நான் இருண்ட காடில் கண்டுபிடித்தேன் / நான் இருண்ட காடில் இருப்பதை கண்டேன் - Line 3: சரியான பாதை இழந்தது / சரியான பாதை காணாமல் போனது / சரியான பாதை தவறாக இருந்தது

### Step 4: Slot-Based Syntactic Assembly Task: Assemble Step3 phrases into Tamil lines; keep the same number of lines. Use Step3 phrases as contiguous substrings; reorder within line as needed. Allowed edits: insert only function-words/morphology for grammatical joining; no new content words. Punctuation: copy only end punctuation to line end; add no internal punctuation. Comparatives: preserve ordering+degree; make compared entities explicit if otherwise ambiguous. Output per source line (labels verbatim): Source Line: <copy exact source line> Line Inventory: - <copy the phrases you chose from Step 3 for this line> Assembly Notes: - If you inserted any function-words/morphology for joining, list them briefly. Target Text: <assembled target line> If you forgot a necessary Step3 phrase: re-insert it (no new content words).

**Source Line:** Nel mezzo del cammin di nostra vita
**Line Inventory:** - நம் வாழ்க்கையின் பாதையின் நடுவில்
**Assembly Notes:** - No additional function‑words needed; the phrase already expresses “midway on the road of our life”.
**Target Text:** நம் வாழ்க்கையின் பாதையின் நடுவில்
---
**Source Line:** mi ritrovai per una selva oscura,
**Line Inventory:** - நான் இருண்ட காடில் தன்னை கண்டேன்
**Assembly Notes:** - No additional function‑words needed; the phrase includes the reflexive “myself” and the locative “within a dark wood”.
**Target Text:** நான் இருண்ட காடில் தன்னை கண்டேன்,
---
**Source Line:** ché la diritta via era smarrita.
**Line Inventory:** - சரியான பாதை இழந்தது
**Assembly Notes:** - Inserted the causal conjunction **ஏனெனில்** (“because”) before the phrase to render the causal “for”.
**Target Text:** ஏனெனில் சரியான பாதை இழந்தது.

### Step 5: Self-Correction via Back-Translation & Grammatical Check For each line: verify Step4 Target Text vs Reference Translation + Step1 Locked Meaning; correct within-line only. Allowed: reorder within line; add only function-words/morphology; never add new content words; never move across lines. Punctuation: keep only end punctuation from source; no internal punctuation. Output per line bullets with EXACT fields (no extras): Line #, Target Text, Back-Translation, Reference Translation, Checks, Corrected Target Text (if any). Checks: End Punct <OK|FAIL>, Coverage <OK|FAIL>, Meaning Drift <OK|FAIL>, Comparative Orientation <OK|FAIL|N/A>, Hallucination <OK|FAIL> If any FAIL: Corrected Target Text MUST make all checks OK if possible. Comparative Orientation: preserve ordering+degree; treat (A>B) ≡ (B<A) and (A<B) ≡ (B>A); FAIL only if ordering reversed or degree lost. After all lines: if any line still FAILs, output UNVERIFIED with failing Line #s; otherwise do not output UNVERIFIED. Output final Tamil text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 1, Target Text: நம் வாழ்க்கையின் பாதையின் நடுவில், Back-Translation: in the middle of our life's road, Reference Translation: Midway upon the road of our life, Checks: End Punct OK, Coverage OK, Meaning Drift OK, Comparative Orientation N/A, Hallucination OK, Corrected Target Text: - Line 2, Target Text: நான் இருண்ட காடில் தன்னை கண்டேன்,, Back-Translation: I found myself in the dark forest, Reference Translation: I found myself within a dark wood,, Checks: End Punct OK, Coverage OK, Meaning Drift OK, Comparative Orientation N/A, Hallucination OK, Corrected Target Text: - Line 3, Target Text: ஏனெனில் சரியான பாதை இழந்தது., Back-Translation: because the right way was lost, Reference Translation: for the right way had been missed., Checks: End Punct OK, Coverage OK, Meaning Drift OK, Comparative Orientation N/A, Hallucination OK, Corrected Target Text:
``` நம் வாழ்க்கையின் பாதையின் நடுவில் நான் இருண்ட காடில் தன்னை கண்டேன், ஏனெனில் சரியான பாதை இழந்தது. ```
